detail.data: 8 invented explain tasks, criteria written first, 10 invented hand-labelled answers each (80). No text comes from a real child.

code.note: Code never says right or wrong: an empty or under-minimum answer asks for a little more (the view's explain_more flag), the rest is kept unjudged for the tutor. It agrees with the hand label only where 'ask for more' is right.

spark.cost_source: responses-api usage + HttpMuse PRICES (not the run ledger: no product run exists for offline judging)
